problem_context.problem_statement: Reverify CircularAreaReset using the unique shared CircularAreaLogicalState and mixed buffer ownership. The function must be callable on every valid state returned by Init, non-force Write, Read, and queries. It must preserve descriptor identity, buffer identity, capacity, canonical head/tail, operations, physical option-byte list and GlobalStrings while resetting readidx, writeidx and status to zero and the logical FIFO to nil.
problem_context.expected_behavior: For every non-null valid unified circular-area state, mutate only readidx=0, writeidx=0 and b_status=0; preserve data_buffer, area_length, operations, p_head=data_buffer, p_tail=data_buffer+area_length, physical option-byte contents and UCharArray::mixed_full; return the shared logical state with logical=nil. No null call is permitted because the real C function dereferences unconditionally.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Use QCIPLib.xizi.xizi_circular_area_common.xizi_circular_area_lib.CircularAreaLogicalState as the only state definition before and after. Pre logical may be arbitrary and post logical must be nil. Use UCharArray::mixed_full before and after with the identical physical list; do not require or manufacture UCharArray::full.
spec_hint: Keep only a pure Reset result/state transition relation local if useful. The post shared invariant is established by area_length>0, physical length preservation, indices 0, status 0, and vacuous CircularAreaLiveBytes for logical nil. Do not duplicate shared descriptor/buffer definitions.
preferred_hidden_properties: direct callpoint composability after Init/Write/Read and before all queries/Write/Read/Release without mixed-to-full conversion
